title: agent action card onboarding strings: regenerate src/lang/default/en.json after editing copy, and let the long setup command wrap in its flex row
answers: I changed the tab label or description text in the agent action card; why does en.json show new and removed message IDs?
The one-line setup command in the empty-state card overflows its box on narrow widths. How do I make it wrap?
How do I update the UI translation catalog after changing a FormattedMessage in the onboarding components?
Where is the 'One-line setup' tab label defined and translated?
body:
Path: UI onboarding strings in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/components/onboarding/AgentActionCard.tsx:AgentActionCard, including the 'One-line setup' tab trigger, the description above the terminal command, and the <code> element that displays the command; their translation catalog is mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json.
Rule: Each FormattedMessage's message ID in en.json is a hash derived from its defaultMessage and description, so editing either string changes the key: the old entry is removed and a new one is added. Regenerate the catalog through the UI i18n tooling rather than hand-editing keys, then check i18n consistency. For a long displayed command, the code element in the flex row needs minWidth: 0 and overflowWrap: 'anywhere' so it wraps instead of pushing the copy button out of the card.
Constraints: Applies to strings rendered by FormattedMessage in the UI. Not needed for plain-text docs or README edits, which have no translation catalog.
applies: Editing copy or layout in the experiment-tracking onboarding agent action card and its en.json message catalog.
says: The setup command in the onboarding card overflows and pushes the copy button outside.
Wrap long terminal instructions inside the setup card so the copy button remains visible.
Editing the onboarding tab label or description caused translation catalog entries to change unexpectedly.
The quick setup command spills out of its container on narrow display widths.
search: When updating UI onboarding strings or layout in mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/components/onboarding/AgentActionCard.tsx:AgentActionCard, regenerate the translation catalog at mlflow/server/js/src/lang/default/en.json using UI i18n tooling because FormattedMessage IDs are hashed from defaultMessage and description. In the empty-state card, displayed commands in code elements inside flex rows require minWidth: 0 and overflowWrap: 'anywhere' so long commands wrap without displacing the copy button. This applies to UI strings rendered by FormattedMessage rather than plain-text docs or README edits.
